title: System Revenue Overview
content: Revenue is calculated from Mission.delivery_fee of completed flight missions (status=COMPLETED or MISSION_COMPLETED). The Admin Dashboard displays total revenue, today's revenue, this month's revenue, and paid order count. There is no separate billing module — fees are computed upon order creation and recognized upon successful delivery.

title: User Management and Role-Based Access Control
content: Admins have permission to: (1) View all users; (2) Create new staff accounts with specific roles; (3) Update user details and promote/demote roles; (4) Lock/unlock accounts (is_active); (5) Delete accounts. Available roles: Admin, Operator, Technician, Customer. Roles are mapped via UUID in the roles table.

title: Audit Logs - Activity History
content: All critical actions (login, order creation, status updates) are recorded in the audit_logs table. Admins inspect audit logs at /system/audit-logs with filters for user_id, action type, resource_table, and time range, with pagination support. Used for incident investigation and security auditing.

title: System Statistics (System KPIs)
content: The Admin Dashboard provides system-wide statistics: user counts by role, total missions and success rate, fleet status (drones by status, average utilization), batteries (total batteries, average charge), and AI predictions (missions with predictions, average energy consumption, and LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH risk distribution).

title: System Configuration Management
content: Admins can configure Hub information (name, address, coordinates, Active/Inactive status) and operational parameters. Important environment variables in .env: GEMINI_API_KEY (AI chatbot), DATABASE_URL (cloud PostgreSQL Supabase), FRONTEND_URL (frontend URL), and BREVO_API_KEY (email notifications).

title: System Alerts and Monitoring
content: Admins monitor: PENDING Maintenance Alerts (requiring Technician action), OPEN Incidents (requiring Operator action), and total audit log entries. Background cron jobs run every 3 seconds (monitoring drone signal loss and overdue mission cancellation) and every 1 hour (maintenance alerts, battery charging, and pickup reminders).

title: Backup and Data Governance
content: The system stores data on cloud PostgreSQL (Supabase), with automated backups managed by Supabase. Admins can export audit logs for archival. Flight telemetry data is retained indefinitely for analytics. Policy: customer data is kept confidential and never shared with third parties.

title: System Technical Architecture
content: DroneOptAI Backend: FastAPI (Python), PostgreSQL + pgvector (Supabase), SQLAlchemy async ORM. AI/ML: CatBoost energy prediction model, SHAP explainability, Google Gemini API for chatbots. Infrastructure: Deployed on Render.com with Supabase database (pgvector enabled). Cron jobs: 2 async loops — realtime (3s) and hourly (3600s) using an isolated DB pool.
